text: Ka Mosupologo, baitsanape ba Sekwele sa Bongaka sa Yunibesithi ya Stanford ba ntsi tse pego ya go re ba dirile sedirisiwa se sesha, se se ka farologanyang madi a motho go ya ka mefuta ya one: tshitswana e nnye fela thata e e ka bopiwang ka porintara fela a malatsi otlhe e e dirisang maranyane a inkjet, ka tlhwatlhwa e e ka tshwarang sente e le nngwe fela ya lefatshe la Amerika.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Badira dipatlisiso ba tlhalosa fa se se tla thusa go tshwara kankere, bolwetse jwa kgotlholo e tona, HIV, le letshoroma go sale gale, mo balwetseng ba ba mo mafatsheng a a humanegileng; ko selekanyetso sa go fola mo malwetsing a a tshwanang le kankere ya mabele se ka nna sephatlo sa kwa mafatsheng a a tlhabologileng.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Sefofane sa Grippen sa JAS 39C se ne sa phatlakana mo motabogelong wa difofane ka nako ya gone kwa ya 9.30 mo mosong (0230UC), mme se sa baka go re boemelo-difofane bo tswalelwe difofane tsa kgwebo.
eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Mokgweetsi wa sefofane se, go senotswe go re ke Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
eng_text: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Bobegadikgang jwa lefelo leo bo begile fa koloi ya setimamolelo ya maemelo-difofane e ne ya pitikologa e le mo letsholong la go thusa mo tiragalong e.
eng_text: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal yo o dingwaga tse 28, o ne a ikgolaganya le setlhopha sa Barca a tswa kwa setlhopheng sa Sevilla, paka tse tharo tse di fetileng.
eng_text: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Fa a sale a fudugela kwa moshateng wa ma-Catalan, Vidal o tshameketse setlhopha se makgetho a le 49.
eng_text: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Popelelo e simolotse ka 11:00 go ya ka nako ya mo gae (UTC+1) kwa Whitehall go lebagana le kgoro e e disitsweng ke mapodise ya mmila wa Downing, kwa legaeng la semmuso la Tonakgolo.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Moragonyana fela ga nako ya lesome le bongwe, bangongoregii ba ile ba thibela dikoloi mo tseleng e e lebileng bokone kwa Whitehall.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Ka nako ya 11:20, mapodise a ne a kopa babopeledi go sutela fa godimo ga bodilo jwa letlhakore la tsela, ba tlhalosa go re ba tlhoka go lekalekanya ditshwanelo tsa go bopelela le motsamao o o oketsegang wa dikoloi.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Ka bonako ya 11:29 mogwanto wa pagamelela go ya kwa Whitehall, wa feta ka Trafalgar Square, mo tseleng ya Strand, wa feta ka Aldwych, wa bo o pagamelela go ya kwa Kingsway go tsamaela kwa Holborn kwa ba lekgotla la polotiki la Conservative Party ba neng ba tshwaretse phuthego ya bone ya dikgakologo mo hoteleng ya Grand Connaught Rooms.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: "Dipampiri tsa Panama" ke lereo le dirisiwang mo ditokomane di ka nna dimilione go tswa kwa setheong sa molao sa kwa Panama e leng Mossack Fonseca, tse di ntshitsweng ka sephiri go ba bega dikgang ka paka ya letlhafula ka ngwaga wa 2016.
eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Dipampiri di bontshitse gore dibanka di le lesome -le-bone di thusitse bahumi go fitlha dikhumo tsa madi a fitlhang go dibilione tsa didolara tsa Amerika go tila go duela makgetho le melawana e mengwe.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Lokwalodikgang lwa Borithane e leng The Guardian le bontsha gore Deutsche Bank e e laolwang ke nngwetharong ya dikhampani di le 1 200 tsa dikgapetla tse di diretsweng go dira seno.
eng_text: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Go ne go na le ditshupetso lefatshe ka bophara, dikatlholo di le mmalwa tsa bokebekwa, mme baeteledipele ba dipuso tsa Iceland le Pakistan ka bobedi ba ne ba rola tiro.
eng_text: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

eng_text: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Nno ya gagwe ya bobedi bosigong joo, e ne e le wa gagwe ya bo masome-a-marataro mo pakeng eo. Se se na sa mo dira motshameki wa ntlha go nosa dinno di le masome-a-marataro kgotsa go feta, mo paleng e le nngwe, fa e sale Jaramir Jagr le Mario Lemieux ba fitlhelela se, ke paka ya 1995-96.

text: Batten o ne a le mo maemong a bo-190 mo lenaaneng la 2008 la ma-Amerika a le 400 a a humileng go gaisa; a na le khumo e e fopholediwang go didolara di le dibilione tse 2.3.

eng_text: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

eng_text: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Jaaka dikoloi tse di neng di le kwa pele ga ga Alonso di ntse di ema go tshela leokwane, di diiwa ke koloi ya tshireletso, o ne a kgona go fetela ko pele, go fitlheleleng a gapa phenyo.
eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr o ne a kobiwa morago ga tikologo ya Hungary ya 2009.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Ka nako ya 8:46am go il ga nna le tidimalo mo toropong, e le segopodiso sa motsotso wa sefofane sa ntlha se thula.
eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Marang a mabedi a lesedi a ageletswe go re a lebe kwa loaping mo bosigong.
eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Kago ya dikago tsa meago e kwa godimo di tsweletse kwa teng. Go tla nna le lefelo la dipalangwa le lefelo la go itlosa bodutu la segopotso mo gare.
eng_text: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Setshwantso sa motshikinyego sa PBS se na le dietsele tsa di-Emmy di di feta masome a bobedi le bone, e bile se tshamekilwe mo nakong e ko tlase go na le sa Sesame Street le sa Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Kgaolo nngwe le nngwe ya tshupegetso e, e itebaganya le moono o o mo bukeng nngwe, abo e sekaseka moono wa teng ka dipolelo tse di farologanyeng.
eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Tshupegetso nngwe le nngwe e ntsha kaelo ya dibuka tse bana ba ka di batlang fa ba ya ko motlobong wa dibuka wa bone.
eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant wa WNED Buffalo (setheo-segolo sa Reading Rainbow) o rile a re "Reading Rainbow e rutile bana mosola wa go bala,... lerato la go bala – [tshupegetso] e rotlweditse bana go tsaya buka le go bala."
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Bangwe, ba ba akaretsang John Grant, ba dumela go re go fokodiwa ga madi a a abelwang bagasi, ga mmogo le go fetola megopolo ka go re kgaso ya dithulaganyo tsa thuto e tshwanetse go nna jang, go nnile le seabe mo go emisiweng ga thulaganyo e.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Balepi ba bua go re go na le kgonafalo e ntsi ya go re matsubutla, a a sekgala sa dimaele di le 645 (1040 km) kwa bophirima jwa ditlhaketlhake tsa Cape Verde, a nyelele pele fa ka nna matshosetsi mo mafelong a a nang le lefatshe.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred mo nakong ya gompieno o na le diphefo tsa selekanyo sa lebelo la dimaele di le 105 ka oura (165km/h) mme o tsamaela ma ntlheng a bokone-bophirima.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred ke sone setshuatshue sa metsi se segolo se se kileng sa bonala bokgala kwa borwa le botlhaba mo Atlantic, sale go similola go tsaya ditshwantsho ka disathalaite; ebile ele setshuatshue sa boraro se bonetse go pota mola wa 35°W ka fa botlhabatsatsi.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Ka ngwaga wa 1759, kgwedi ya Lwetse e le 24, Arthur Guinness o ne a saena tumalano ya bonno ya dingwaga tse 9,000 ya lefelo le go ritelwang bojalwa la St James' Gate Brewery kwa Dublin, Ireland.
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Morago ga dingwaga di le 250, Guinness e godile go nna kgwebo ya mafatshefatshe, e e dirang madi a a fetang dibilione tsa di-euro di le lesome (US$14.7 billion) ngwaga le ngwaga.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Mokgweetsi-mmogo wa A1GP, Jonny Reid wa setlhopha sa New Zealand, o ile a dira ditso gompieno ka go kgweetsa ka lobelo lo lo kwa godimo lo lo mo molaong go feta Auckland Habour Bridge e e dingwaga di le 48, kwa New Zealand.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Rre Reid o ne a kgona go kgweetsa koloi e ntsha ya leina la Black Beauty ya New Zealand A1GP, ka lobelo lwa a sekgele sa dikhilomithara tse di lekgolo le masome a marataro ka oura, a kgabaganya leboro ka makgetlho a le supa.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Ba sepodisi sa New Zealand ba nnile le bothata go dirisa lenaka le le balang bofefo go bona go re Rre Reid o ne a tabogile jang ka ntlha ya go re koloi ya Black Beauty e ko tlase, mme nako fela e mapodise ba kgonneng go tshwara Rre Reid e le fa a fokotsa lobelo go ya ko go sekgele sa dikhilomithara tse 160 ka aura.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Mo dikgweding tse 3 tse di fitileng, batshwarwa ba feta 80 ba golotswe go tsweng kwa lefelo legolo la batshwarwa kwa ntle ga go lebisiwa molato semmuso.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ka Moranang monongwaga, taelo ya kganelo ya nakwana e ne ya ntshiwa ke Moatlhodi Glynn kgatlhanong le setheo go pateletsa go gololwa ga ba ba ntseng ba tshwere dioura di feta 24 fa ba sena go tsewa mme ba sa amogela ditheetso tsa motsamaisi wa kgotlatshekelo.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Molaodi o baya tlhwatlhwa ya madi a kgololo, fa kopo ya teng e atlegile, a bo a bega semmuso, ditatofatso tse di begilweng ke lepodise le le tshwereng mmelaelwa. Go tsweng foo, ditatofatso tse di tsenngwa mo khomputareng, go re kgetse ya teng e kgone go salwa morago motlhofo.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Tsheko e tshwaa letsatsi le mmelaelwa a nnang le tshwanelo ya go re tsheko ya gagwe e reediwe ka pela.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Rre Peter Costello, motshwaramatlotlo wa Australia, gape e le rre yo a neng aka atlega go tlhatlhama Tonakgolo John Howard yo e leng moeteledipele wa lekoko la sepolitiki la Liberal o tlhalositse thotoetso ya gagwe e ntsi ya fetlha motlakase ka magala mo Ustralia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Rre Costello a re fa go dirwa ga maatla a nuklea go siamela itsholelo, Australia e tshwanetse go latelela tiriso ya one.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Fa e ka nna e tlisang kgwebo, re tshwanetse ra nna le yone. Ga go na molao o teng o ganetsang go fetlha motlakase ka magala, ga bua jalo rre Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Mapodisi a ne a re Lo Picco o mo maemong a kwa godimo ka go re o nnile mothusi wa ga Provenzano kwa Palermo, le maitemogelo a maemo a kwa godimo tse di fi leng tlotla ya baeteledipele ba mabutswa pele fa ba rotoetsa molao wa ga Provenzano wa go iketla mme ba ntse ba nonotsha maatla a ditirisano.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Bagolwane ba, ba ne ba setse ba laolwa ke Provenzano fa a ne a tlisa pheletso ntwa kgatlhanong le mmuso o eteletswe pele ke Riina. Ntwa e e neng ya gapa matshelo a batlhani ba mmafia e bong Giovanni Falcone le Paolo Borsellino ka ngwaga was 1992."
eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

eng_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazil ke lefatshe le le tumileng ka tumelo ya se Roman Catholic mo lefatsheng, mme kereke ya Roman Catholic e tlhamaletse kgatlhanong le go molao o o letang go nyalana ga batho ba bong bole bongwe.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Palamente ya Brazil e na le sebaka sa dingwaga tse 10 e ntse e ngangisanya ka kgang ya go letlelela manyalo a, mme go fitlha jaana manyalo a go nna jalo a letlelelwa fela kwa Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Molao-kakanyetso wa ntlha o ne wa kwalwa ke rratoropo wa pele Sao Paulo, mme molao-kakanyetso o, morago ga go baakanngwa, jaanong o mo diatleng tsa ga Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Badiraditshupetso ba solofela go amogela kopo ya mesaeno e le sedikadike tse 1, 2 go e isa kwa Lekgotla kgolo la sechaba ka Ngwanatsele.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Morago ga itemogelo ya go re bontsi jwa malwapa a ne a batla thuso ya semolao go ka lwantsha go fodusiwa mo go seng ka fa molaong, bokopano bo ne ba tshwarwa ka Mopitlo a tlhola malatsi a le 20, kwa East Bay Community Law Centre go buisana ka batswa-setlhabelo ba botsotsi jwa matlo.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Fa bahirisi ba simolola go abelana se se ba tlhagetseng, bontsi jwa malwapa a a ne a amega a ile a lemoga g ne foo go re Carolyn Wilson wa OHA o utsule madi a bone a peeletso, a bo a sia a tswa ka toropo.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Bahirisi kwa Lockwood Gardens ba dumela go re go ka tswa go na le malwapa a magwe a le 40 kgotsa go feta, ba ba tla itemogelang go kobiwa, jaaka ba ile ba itemogela gor e mapodise a OHA a dira dipatlisiso tsa ditheo tsa matlo a sechaba kwa Oakland tse di ka tswang di iphetlhela mo bogwenegweneng jwa matlo.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Setlhopha se emisitse maitiso a mmino a a neng a ya go tshwarelwa kwa lebaleng la Maui War Memorial, a go neng go solofetswe go re a tla tsenelelwa ke batho ba le 9000, mme sa ikopa maitshwarelo mo balateding.
eng_text: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Babueledi ba ba tumileng ba Greek, Sakis Kechagioglou le George Nikolakopoulos ba tshegeditswe kwa Athens, mo kgolegelong ya Korydallus, ba sena g bonwa molato wa go dirisa botlhaswa maemo a bo ne go ikhumisa le wa tshenyetso sechaba.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Ka ntlha ya se, matlhabisaditlhong mo setlhopha sa sa ithutetseng molao, se upoloditse ditiro tse di seng ka fa malaong tsa baatlhodi, babueledi, ba ba ithutetseng molao, le diagente ba di dirileng ngwaga tse di fetileng.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Dibeke tse di mmalwa tse di fetileng, morago ga molaetsa o o anamisitsweng ke mmegadikgang Makis Triantafylopoulos mo lenaneong la gagwe la thelebishine le le tumileng la "Zoungla" mo Alpha TV, leloko le la Palamente gape e le mmueledi, Petros Mantouvalos o ne a rolwa maemo jaaka maloko a ofisi ya gagwe ba ne ba amega mo go ikhumiseng ba dirisa maemo a bone le tshenyetso sechaba.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Mo godimo ga se, moatlhodi wa maemo Evangelos Kalousis o tshegeditswe kwa kgolegelong, a se na go bonwa molato wa tshenyetso sechaba le go tlhoka go itshwara sentle.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Fa kurwana e tsena mo lefatsheng e bo e tsena mo moweng ka nako ya bo 5am (Nako ya letlhakore la botlhabatsatsi), go solofelwa go re e tla direla batho ba kwa bokone jwa California, Oregon, Nevada, le Utah tshupetso ya lesedi e e mabono.
eng_text: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Kurwana, e tla tshwana le naledi e e mogatlana e ralela loapi.
eng_text: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

eng_text: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust e tla baya nako e ncha e e khutshwane go fetisa, ya sesutlhalefaufau go boela mo Lefatsheng, e phala nako e e sa bolong go bewa ke Apollo X ka Motsheganong wa 1969.
eng_text: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: "Se se ka tsamaela kwa ditshitshing tsa bophirima jwa bokone jwa California e bile se tla phatshimisa loapi go tswa California go kgabaganya bogare jwa Oregon le go ralala Nevada le Idaho go fitlha kwa Utah," ga rialo Tom Duxbury, yo e leng motsamaisi wa porojeke ya Stardust.
eng_text: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Tshwetso e tserweng ke Mr. Rudd go saena tumalano ya tsa maemo a bosa le Kyoto e tlhaola United States, e e leng yone fela e e yang go nna sechaba se se tlhabologileng go ka naya tetla ya tumalano eo.
eng_text: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: O ile a thusiwa ka ponyo ya leitlho ke badiri ba ditirelo tsa kalafi ba mo tselaneng ya kgaisano le go isiwa kwa bookelong jo bo gaufi kwa a ileng a tlhokafala teng moragonyana.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat o ne a sa gobala mo kotsing.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Malebana le seemo sa lefatshe sa tsa madi, Zapatero o ile a tswelela ka go re "tsamaiso ya madi ke karolo ya itsholelo, karolo e e masisi.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Re na le mathata a madi a ka tsayang ngwaga, mo e nnileng mathata thata mo dikgweding tse pedi tse di fitileng, mme jaanong ke akanya go re mebaraka ya tsa madi e simolola go tokafala.
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Beke e fetileng, ba Naked news ba begile go re go tsile go nna le koketsego ya dipuo tse ba begang dikgang ka tsone, ka dikgaso tse tharo tse disha.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Jaaka ba setse ba bega ka Sekgowa le se-Japan, setheo se sa lefatshe ka bophara se tlhoma dithulaganyo tsa puo ya se-Spain, se-Italy le se-Korea tsa thelebishini, maranyane le megala ya letheka.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Ka lesego ga gona sepe se se ntiragaletseng, mme ke bone ttiragalo e e boifisang, fa batho ba leka go thuba matlhabaphefo ba leka go tswela ko ntle.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Batho ba ne ba betsa digalase ka ditulo, mme matlhabaphefo a ne a sa thubege.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Nngwe ya digalase kwa bofelong e ne ya thubega, mme ba simolola go tswela kwa ntle ka matlhabaphefo, ga bolela mongwe wa bafalodi e leng Franciszek Kowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Dinaledi di ntsha lesedi le mogote ka ntlha ya maatla a nnang gone fa diathomo tsa hydrogen di kopanngwa (kgotsa tswakantswe) mmogo go dira dielemente tse di boketenyana.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Baitsesaense ba a bereka go dira sefetlha maatla se se ka kgonang go dira go re go dirwe maatla ka tsela e e tshwanang.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Mme gone, seno, ke bothata jo bo nonofileng mme go tsile go tsaya dingwaga go re re bone di difetlha-molelo tse di mosola di agiwa.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Nnale ya tshipi e kokobala mo godimo ga metsi ka ntlha ya kgagamalo ya boalo.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Dikgogakgogano mo boalong di diragala ka go nne dimolekhule tsa mo boalong jwa metsi di gogelana thata go feta jaaka di ntse mo phefong e e ko godimo ga tsone.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Dimolekhule tsa metsi di bopa letlalo la metsi le le sa bonaleng fa godimo ga metsi le le letlang go re dilo tse di tshwanang le nnalete di kokobale mo godimo ga metsing.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Legare le le mo sereleding sa aese le magale mabedi a a obegelegang ka fa gare a a nang le phatlha fa gare ga one. Magale mabedi ano a dira a tshware botoka mo aeseng, tota le fa a sekamisitswe.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: E re ka bokafatlase jwa legare bo sokame go le gonnye, fa legare le sokamela kwa letlhakoreng le lengwe go ya kwa go le lengwe, letlhakore le le amang aese le lone le a sekama.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Seno se dira go re motho yo o relelang mo aeseng a retologe. Fa direledi mo aeseng di sekamela ka fa mojeng, motho yo o relelang mo aeseng o ya ka fa mojeng, mme fa di sekamela ka fa molemeng, o ya ka fa molemeng.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Go boela kwa selekanyong sa maatla se se fetileng, di tshwanetse go tswa tlogela maatla a a oketsegileng a di a boneng go tswa mo leseding.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ba dira se ka go ntsha lebonenyana le le nnye le le bidiwang "photon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Baitsesaense ba bitsa tsamaiso eno go re ke "go ntshiwa ga marang a a fetlhilweng" ka go nne diathomo di fetlhwa ke lesedi le le tsabakelang, le le bakang go re go ntshiwe photon ya lesedi, mme lesedi ke nngwe ya mofuta wa marang.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Setshwantsho se se latelang se bontsha diathomo di ntsha di-photon. Mme gone, boammaaruri ke go re di-photon di dinnye thata go na le tseo di leng mo setshwantshong.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Di-photon di dinnye thata go na le dilo tse di dirang di-athomo.
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Morago ga sebaka sa diora tse di makgolo, lebone le ne la felela le sha le bole sa tlhole le bereka.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Tleloupu mme e tlhoka go fetolwa. Go botlhokwa go nna kelotlhoko fa o fetola tleloupu.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Sa ntlha, go tshwanetse go re go tingwe motlakase o o yang kwa leboneng, kgotsa thapo ya teng, e somolwe.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Se ke ka go re motlakase o tsamaya mo soketeng kwa go nang le karolo ya tshitswana teng mme o ka tlabolwa ke motlakase thata fa o ka tshwara boteng jwa sokete kgotsa kutu ya tleleoupu e e nang le tshitswana fa karolwana ya yone e santse e le mo soketeng.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Serwe se segolo sa modikologo wa madi ke pelo, e e pompang madi.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Madi a tswa mo pelong ka ditshika tse di bidiwang diatheri a bo a boela mo pelong ka dipeipe tse di bidiwang diveini. Dipeipi tse dinnye di bidiwa ditshikana.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Meno a triceratops a ne a kgona go sila matlhare ga mmogo le dikgala tse di thata.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Banetetshi bangwe ba akanya go re triceratops e ne e ja di-cycad - mofuta wa dimela tse di neng di atile thata mo pakeng ya Cretaceous.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ditlhare tse di lebega jaaka ditlhare tsa palm tse di nnye, tse di mathare a a motswi.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops e ka tswa a ne e dirisa molomo wa yone o o thata go tlhobola mathare mo sethareng pele e ja thito.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Baitsanape ba bangwe ba ngangisana go re ditlhare tse di botlhole thata; se se rayang go re ga go na dinosaur e e neng e di ja, le ntswa malatsatsing ano diphologolo tse dingwe le dinonyane tse di tona (dikokomana tsa di-dinosaurs) di kgona go ja matlhare a maungo a a nang le botlhole.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kgogelofatshe ya Io e ka nna jang mo go nna? Fa o ka ema mo Io, bokete ja ga go bo ka nna ko tlase go na le fa o le me Lefatsheng.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Motho wa bokete ja 200 pounds (90kg) mo Lefatsheng, o ka nna bokete ja 36 pounds (16kg) ko Io. Jalo, kgogelofatshe ga e go goge mo go kalo.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Letsatsi ga le na legogo le o kgonang go ema mo go lone jaaka Lefatshe. Letsatsi lotlhe le dirilwe ka mewa, molelo le metlakase.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mowa o a hokotsega fa o ntse o tswa mo bogareng ba letsatsi.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Selo se re se bonang mo bokafantleng jwa letsatsi se bidiwa photosphere, mo go rayang go re ”kgolokwe ya lesedi”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Morago ga dingwaga tse dikete tse tharo, ka 1610, molebeledi wa dinaledi wa kwa Italy Galileo Galilei o dirisitse selebakgakala sa dinaledi go lemoga fa Venus e na le maphata a mabedi, fela jaaka ngwedi.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Di pharologanyo di diragala ka go re ke fela karolo ya naledi (kana ya ngwedi) ke e e lebileng ko letsatsing fela e e tshubang. Maphata a a Venus a rurifaditse kakanyetso ya ga Copernicus ya go re dipolanete di dikologa latsatsi.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Mme, dingwaga di le mmalwa moragonyana ka 1639, moithutadinaledi wa Moesemane yo o bidiwang Jeremiah Horrocks o ne a bona go fetoga ga Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Lefatshe la England le ne le ntse ka kagiso mo lebakeng le leele morago ga go gapa Danelaw gape.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Mme ka 991 Ethelred o ne a lebanwa ke masole amba-Viking a mantsi go feta ape fa e sale a ga Guthrum dingwaga di le lekgolo pelenyana.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Boidiidi jo bo ne bo eteletswe ke Olaf Trygvasson, monna wa mo-Norway, ka maikaelelo a go ntsha lefatshe la ga gabo mo pusong ya ma-Danish.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Morago ga go busediwa morago ke dilo tsa sesole, Ethelred o ne a kgona go dumelana le Olaf, yo o boetseng ko Norway go ya go leka go tsaya bogosi jwa gagwe ka phenyo e tlhakatlhakaneng.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ke tsone fela ditlhaka tse di dirilweng ka maikaelelo, tse di dirisiwang thata gompieno. Ditlhaka tse di dirilwe ka 1444 ka nako ya Kgosi Sejong (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Kgosi Sejong e ne e le kgosi ya bone mo Bogosing jwa boora-Joseon mme ke mongwe yo o neng a tseelwa ko godimo thata.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Kwa tshimologong o ne a taya alfabete ya Hangeul leina la Hunmin Jeongeum, le le kayang "medumo e e siametseng go ka dirisediwa go ruta batho".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Go na le di dikgopolo tse dintsi tsa ka moo Sanskrit e tlholegileng ka teng. Nngwe ya tsone e kaga go fuduga ga ma-Aryan go tswa kwa botlhaba ba bo ba tsena mo India mme ba tla ka puo ya bone.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ke puo ya bogologolo e tshwanang le puo ya se Selatine e e neng e buiwa kwa Yuropa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buka ya pele e e itsegeng mo lefatsheng ene e kwadilwe ka se Sanskrit. Morago ga gore Upanishads e kgobokanngwe, Sanskrit e ile ya nyelela ka ntlha ya thulaganyotatelano.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ke puo e e thata tota e e humileng, e e leng yone e diteme tse dintsi tsa segompieno tsa letso la se-India di simolotseng ka yone, fela jaaka Selatine se simolotse dipuo tsa Yuropa tse di jaaka Sefora le se-Spain.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: E re ka ntwa ya go lwela Fora e fedile, Jeremane ya simolola go ipaakanyetsa go tlhasela setlhaketlhake sa Boritane.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Jeremane e ne ya bitsa tlhaselo eo "Operation Sealion". Bontsi jwa dibetsa tse di bokete tsa Masole a Borithane le ditlamelo di ile tsa latlhega fa e ne e ntshiwa go tswa kwa Dunkirk, ka gone sesole se ne se le bokoa.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mme fela Masole a Segosi a mo Lewatleng a ne a santse a na le maatla go gaisa Masole a mo Lewatleng a Jeremane ("Kriegsmarine") mme a ka bo nne a ile a senya sesole sepe fela se se thopang se se rometsweng go ralala Mosele wa Engelane.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, dikepe di sekaenyana fela tsa Masole a Segosi a mo Lewatleng di ne di nna gaufi le ditsela tse di tlogang di tlhaselwa jaaka baetapele ba sesole ba ne ba tshaba go re ba tla nwediwa mo metsing ke tlhaselo ya mo loaping ya Jeremane.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tla re simolole ka go tlhalosa maikaelelo a lefatshe la Ithali. Ithali e ne e le ”monnawe” lefatshe la Jeremane le la Japane.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: E ne e na le sesole se se bokoa sa mo lefatsheng le sa mo lewatleng, ntswa ba ne ba sa tswa go aga dikepe tse nne tse disha pele ga ntwa e simolola.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Maikaelelo magolo a Italy e ne e le dinaga tsa Aforika. Go gapa dinaga tseo, e ne e tla tlhoka go nna le boalo jwa bogorogelo jwa masole, e le go re masole a kgone go kgabaganya Lewatle la Mediterranean ka sekepe le go tlhasela Aforika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ka ntlha ya seo, ba ile ba tshwanelwa ke go fedisa mafelo a masole le dikepe tsa Borithane kwa Egepeto. Kwa ntle ga ditiragalo tseo, dikepe tsa ntwa tsa Italy di ne di sa tshwanelwa ke go dira sepe.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Jaanong re bua ka lefatshe la Japane. Lefatshe la Japane e ne e le setlhaketlhake fela jaaka Borithane.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Dikepe tsa ka fa tlase ga lewatle ke dikepe tse di diretsweng go tsamaya ka fa tlase ga metsi, mme di kgona go nna koo lobaka lo lo leele tota.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Dikepe tsa ka fa tlase ga lewatle di ne di dirisiwa ka Ntwa ya Lefatshe ya Ntlha le ya Bobedi. Ka nako eo di ne di le bonya e bile di ne di sa kgone go thunyetsa kgakala.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Kwa tshimologong ya ntwa bontsi jwa sebaka di ne di tsamaya mo godimo ga lewatle, mme fa didiriswa tsa go tsibosa di simolola go tlhabololwa le go nepa dilo le go feta, dikepe tsa ka fa tlase ga lewatle di ne tsa patelesega go ya kwa tlase ga metsi go tila go re di seka tsa bonwa.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Dikepe tsa ka fa tlase ga lewatle tsa Jeremane di ne di bidiwa U-Boats. Majeremane a ne a na le kitso e e tseneletseng ya go tsamaisa dikepe tsa bone tsa ka fa tlase ga metsi le go di tsenya mo tirisong.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Morago ga ntwa, lefatshe la Jerenane le ne le sa tshepiwe go ka nna le dikepe tsa ka fa tlase ga metsi di le dintsi, ka ntata ya katlego e le neng le nnile le yone mo tirisong ya dikepe tse.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: E e! Kgosi Tutankhamun, yo ka dinako dingwe a bidiwang "Kgosi Tut", kana" Mosimane wa Kgosi", ke mongwe wa dikgosi tse di itsiweng thata tsa bogologolo tsa lefatshe la Egepeto mo dinakong tsa segompieno.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Se se kgatlhang ke go re, o ne a sa tsewe a le botlhokwa thata jalo mo dinakong tsa bogologolo mme ga a ka a rekotiwa mo bontsing jwa manaane a dikgosi tsa bogologogolo.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, go utololwa ga lebitla la gagwe ka ngwaga wa 1922 go mo dirile go re e nne motho yo o itsegeng thata. Lefa mabitla a le mantsi a mo nakong e fetileng a ile a thukuthiwa, lebitla leno lone le ne la seka la kgomiwa le go kgomiwa.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Bontsi jwa dilo tse di fitlhilweng le Tutankhamun di ne di somaretswe sentle, go akaretsa le dilwana tsa bogologolo di le diketekete tse di dirilweng ka tshipi le matlapana a a tlhwatlhwakgolo a a sa bonweng motlhofo.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Motlhodi wa maotwana a a itsamaisang o dirile go re dikaraki tsa ma-Asiria tsa ntwa di nne motlhofo, di nne lobelo le go ema sentle go ka sia masole le di dikaraki tse dingwe tsa ntwa.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Metswi e e tswang mo boreng jwa bone jo bo borai e ne e kgona go phunyeletsa mo seaparong sa phemelo sa masole a ba lwang nao. Mo e ka nnang ka 1000 B.C., ma-Asiria a ne a simolodisa sesole sa ntlha sa dipitse.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Calvary ke masole a lwanelang mo morago ga pitse. Setulo se se mo morago ga pitse se ne ise se diriwe, jaanong maAssyrian bane ba lwanela mo mokwatleng wa pitse yo o senag sepe.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Re itse borradipolotiki ba Magerika ba le bantsi, baitsesaense, le bataki. Go ka direga go re motho yo o itsegeng thata wa setso seno ke Homer, mogaka wa mmoki wa sefofu, yo o tlhamileng dikgatiso tse pedi tsa botswerere tsa Segerika: maboko a Iliad le Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles le Aristophanes e santse e le bakwadi ba metshameko ba ba rategang e bile metshameko ya bone e tsewa e le nngwe ya ditiro tse dikgolo go gaisa fa go tliwa mo bokwading jwa lefatshe.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Mogerika mongwe yo o itsegeng ke rradipalo e bong Pythagoras, yo a itsegeng thata ka mokgwa wa gagwe o o itsegeng wa dikamano tsa matlhakore a dikhutlotharo.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Go na le diphopholetso tse di farologaneng tsa go re ke batho ba le ba kae ba ba buang se-Hindi. Go fopholediwa go re e fa gare ga go nna puo ya bobedi le ya bone e e buiwang thata mo lefatsheng.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Palo ya batho ba ba buang puo ya bone ya tlholego ba a farologana go ya ka go re a palo ya ya tsela ya go bua e amana gaufi thata kgotsa nnyo.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Phopholetso e simolola go tloga go dimilione di le 340 go ya go di le 500 tsa dibui, mme bontsi jo bo ka nnang kana ka dimilione di le 800 bo ka tlhaloganya puo.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Teme ya Hindi le ya Urdu di tshwana ka puo mme di farologana mo go kwaleng; fa go tserwe dikgang tsa letsatsi le letsatsi, babui ba diteme tsoo-pedi go le ga ntsi ba a tlhaloganyana.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Ka nako ya lekgolo la dingwaga la bo-15, Estonia bokone e ne e le ka fa tlase ga tlhotlheletso e kgolo ya setso sa Jeremane.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Baruti bangwe ba ma-Jeremane ba ne ba batla go atametsa Modimo mo bathong ba ba tlholegang mo lefelong le, ka jalo ba simolola teme e e seng bofitlha ya se-Estonia .
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: E ne e theilwe mo alfabeteng ya Sejeremane mme tlhaka e le nngwe "Õ/õ" e ne ya tsenngwa.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Fa nako e ntse e ya, mafoko a le mantsi a adimilweng go tswa mo Sejeremaneng a ile a kopana. Seno e ne e le tshimologo ya go sedifalelwa.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ka tlwaelo, moja-boswa wa bogosi o ne a tlhamalela ko sesoleng fela ga a fetsa sekolo.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, Charles o ne a ya mmadikolo kwa Trinity College, Cambridge ko a neng a ithutela boitseanape jwa Anthropology le Archaelogy, mme moragonya Hisetori, mme a falola ka 2.2(seetsele sa boleng jwa bobedi jo bo potlana).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles e ne ele motho wa ntlha wa Lelapa la Segosi sa Borithane go abelwa dikirii.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkey ya Yuropa (botlhaba jwa Thrace kgotsa Rumelia kwa seoding sa Balkan) e akaretsa 3% ya naga.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Tshimo ya kwa Turkey e bogolo jo bo fetang dikhilomithara di le 1,600 (dimaele di le 1,000) ka boleele le dikhilomithara di le 800 (dimaele di le 500) ka bophara, ka sebopego se e batlang e nna khutlonne-tsepa.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Lefelo la Turkey, go akaretsa le matsha, le disekwere khilomithara di le 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), tse mo go tsone disekwere khilomithara di le 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) di leng kwa borwa-bophirima jwa Asia le disekwere khilomithara di le 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) di leng kwa Yuropa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Nngwe ya dilo tse di nonofileng ka Charlotte, North Carolina, ke gore e na le motlele wa ditlhopho tsa maemo a a kwa godimo tsa malapa.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey e potapotilwe ke mawatle mo matlhakoreng a mararo: Lewatle la Aegean go ela ka fa Bophirima, Lewatle le Lentsho go ela ka kwa bokone le Lewatle la Mediterranean go ela ka kwa Borwa.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg e na le hisetori ya lobaka lo lo leele mme boipuso jwa yone bo nnile gone go tloga ka 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dikarolo tsa segompieno tsa Belgium e ne e le karolo ya Luxembourg mo nakong e e fetileng mme ya nna karolo ya Belgium morago ga Phetogo ya kwa Belgium ya bo-1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg ga e bolo go nna e leka go nna naga e e itlhaotseng mme gone e ne ya ikamanya le Ntwa ya Lefatshe ya Ntlha le Ntwa ya Lefatshe ya Bobedi ka bobedi jwa tsone tsa Jeremane.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ka 1957 Luxembourg e ile ya nna leloko la setlhopha se se simolotseng mokgatlo o gompieno o itsiweng e le European Union.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ke kago ya phemelo e e senyegileng le matlo a baitlami ba ma-Buddha kwa karolong e e kwa godingwana ya Kgaolo ya Paro (kwa Motseng wa Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Go bolelwa go re ka ngwaga wa 1649, Zhabdrug Ngawang Namgyel o ne a tlhama kago ya phemelo go keteka phenyo ya gagwe kgatlhanong le masole a Tibetan-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ka 1951, molelo o o neng wa tlhosediwa o ne wa sadisa fela masalela Drukgyal Dzong, tse di jaaka ditshwantso tsa Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Morago ga molelo, kago eno ya phemelo e ne ya baakanngwa le go sirelediwa, mme ya nna yone fela e e setseng ya mafelo a a ngokang kgatlhego a kwa Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Mo dingwageng tsa bo-1700, lefatshe la Cambodia le iphitlhetse le pinyeletswe ke mafatshe a mabedi a a nang le maatla, a Thailand le Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ba-Thai ba ne ba tlhasela Cambodia makgetlho a le mmalwa mo lekgolong la bo-18 la dingwaga mme ka 1772 ba ne ba senya Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mo dingwageng tsa bofelo tsa bo 1700, ma-Vietnam le bone ba ne ba tlhasela Cambodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Diperesente di le lesome-le-borobedi tsa batho ba kwa Venezuela ga ba na ditiro, mme bontsi jwa bao ba dirang ba a ipereka ka go itirela dikgwebonyana.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Nngwe-peding ya batho ba kwa Venezuela ba ba dirang ba mo ditirong tsa ditirelo, mo e ka nnnang sephatlo sa bone ba dira mo madirelong, mme nngwe-tlhanong ya bone ba dira mo temo-thuong.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Kgwebo ya botlhokwa mo bathong ba Venezuela ke lookwane, koo naga e leng yone e e romelang lookwane kwa dinageng tse dingwe go gaisa, le fa gone e le peresente e le nngwe fela ya batho e e dirang kwa bodirelong jwa lookwane.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Go sa le gale mo go ipuseng ga setṡhaba, boramatlhale ba Singapore Botanic Gardens ba ile ba thusa go tlhabolola setlhaketlhake go nna tshingwana e ntle e e longola mo toropong.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ka 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, lelomo la kwa tshimologong la orchid le ne la tlhophiwa go nna lelomo la bosechaba la naga.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Ngwaga le ngwaga ka Diphalane diphologolo tse di jang dimela di le dimilione di le 1.5 di tsaya mosepele go ela kwa dipoeng tse di kwa borwa, di tshela noka ya Mara, go tswa kwa dithoteng tse di kwa bokone di latelela dipula.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Go tswa fo di boela gape kwa bokone di feta ka fa bophirima, di tshela gape noka ya Mara, morago ga dipula ka kgwedi ya Moranang.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Kgoalo ya Seregenti le akaretsa mafelo a Serengeti National Park, Ngorongoro Conservation Area, le Maswa Game Reserve kwa Tanzania; le Maasai Mara National Reserve kwa Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Go ithuta go dirisa tirisano ya metswedi ya tshedimosetso e tlhokana le bokgoni jo bo tlwaelesegileng le jwa segologolo, ga mmogo le didirisiwa tse di ithutilweng mo dithutong tsa batho ba dirisana mmogo (moseletsele, pou le setshwantso sa motshikinyego, go bolela dipolelo, le tse dingwe).
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Tiriso ya maranyane ya ”Interactive Design” e batla o itsekatsheka le dikakanyo tse o ntseng o na le tsone mabapi le maranyane a tshedimosetso; ebile o ithute go akanya ka ditsela tse di farologanyeng
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Ditlhamiwa tse di dirisanang mmogo di tlhoka go re dikarolwana tsa porojeke di golagane mmogo, mme gape di tlhaloganyesege fa di ikemetse ka nosi.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Mathata a dilense tse di godisang bogolo ke go re go raraana ga pono le palo e e tlhokegang ya dikarolwana tsa dilense go re go fitlhelelwe boleele jo bo farologaneng jwa pono di dikgolo thata go feta tsa dilense tsa pono e e tsepameng.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Seno ga e tlhole e le nna bothata jo bo kalo ka go nne badiri ba dilense ba fitlhelela ditekanyetso tsa maemo a kwa godimo fa ba dira dilense.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Se se kgontshitse dikapa-ditshwantsho tsa leitlho le le atologang go re di kgone go tsaya dinepe tsa boleng jo bo tshwanang le ja tsa leitlho le le sa atologeng.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Bokowa jo bongwe jwa dilense tse di oketsang setshwantsho ke go re befefo jwa tsone bo ko tlase.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Seno se dira go re go nne thata go dirisa dilense tse di sa tureng tse di godisang bogolo mo maemong a a nang le lesedi le le nnye kwa ntle ga go dirisa foleshe.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Bongwe jwa bothata jo bo tlwaelegileng fa o leka go fetolela filimi kwa sebopegong sa DVD ke go tshwantsha phetelela.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Dithelebishene di le dintsi di dirilwe ka tsela e e tla itumedisang batho ka kakaretso.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ka ntlha ya seo, sengwe le sengwe se o se bonang mo thelebisheneng se ile sa segwa melelwane, kwa godimo, kwa tlase le kwa thoko.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Se se diretswe go netefatsa go re setshwantsho se khurumetse sekirini sotlhe. Seo se bidiwa go tshwantsha phetelela.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ka maswabi, fa o dira DVD, go na le kgonagalo ya gore dithoko tsa yone di segege le tsone, ebile fa setshwantsho sa teng sa motshikinyego se na le mokwalo o o tlhalosang ditiragalo o o kwaletsweng kwa tlase thata, o ka nna wa se bonale. kwa tlase e ekotlasethata e tlabe e sabonale.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Dikago tsa phemelo tse di tlwaelegileng tsa bogologolo ga di bolo go nna di tlhotlheletsa dikakanyo, di akantsha motho ka batshameki ba batlhabani, mekete e megolo le batlhabani ba motlha wa ga Arthur.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Tota le fa o eme fela mo gare ga marope a teng a a nang le dingwaga di le dikete go motlhofo go re o simolole go akanya ka medumo le menkgo ya ntwa tse di fetileng bogologolo, e nna e kete o utlwa le go kiba ga tlhako mo matlapaneng le go nkgelwa ke letsholo se se tswang mo teng ga megogoro ya ntlo-lehitshwana.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: A mme gone dikakanyo tsa rona di theilwe mo ditiragalong tsa nnete? Le teng ke ka ntlha yang fa dikago tsa phemelo di ile tsa agiwa? Di ne di tsa tlhamiwa le go agiwa jang?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Jaaka fa go ne go tlwaelegile ka nako eo, Kago ya Phemelo ya Kirby Muxloe go bonala e le ntlo ya tshireletso go na le go nna kago ya phemelo ya mannete.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Difenstere tsa yone tse di tona le mabota a a masesanyane, ne di ka seke tsa kgona go emelela tlhaselo e e mashetla lebaka le le leele.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ka dingwaga tsa bo-1480, fa go agiwa ga yone go ne go simololwa ke Lord Hastings, go ne go re na kagiso e e rileng mo nageng mme e bile tshireletso e ne e tlhokega fela kgatlhanong le setlhotshwana sa digongwana tse di ebelang le go tsamaya di senya.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Selekalekano sa taolo ene ele seemo se mafatshe a Yuropa a neng a se batla gore a kgone go ikemela ka nos jaaka dinaga ta Yuropai.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Kakanyo e ne e le go re dichaba tsotlhe tsa Yuropa di tshwanetse go batla go thibela sechaba se le sengwe go re se seka sa nna le maatla a mantsi, ka go rialo puso ya bosetšhaba go le ga ntsi e ne e fetola diselammapa tsa yone go re e le go re go nne ntse go na le tekatekano.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ntwa ya Boswa-ja-puso ya Spain ke yone ya ntlha e go neng go lwelwa dithata tsa go busa.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Se se ne e tshwaya nako ya phetogo ya bothokwa, mo mafatshe a Yuropa a ka seke a tlhola a lwa dintwa mo leineng la tumelo. Ka jalo, ”Ntwa ya Dingwaga di le Masome a Mararo” e ne e le ntwa ya bofelo go bidiwa ntwa ya tumelo.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tempele ya Artemis kwa Efeso e ne ya senngwa ka di-21 tsa Phukwi, 356 BCE ka go e tlhosetsa ka molelo ka boomo go go dirilweng ke Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Go ya ka kgang ya teng, o ne a tlhotlhelediwa ke go batla go tuma go sa kgathalesege go re o latlhegelwa go le go kae. Baefeso ka ntlha ya kgalefo, ba ile ba itsise go re leina la Herostratus le ka motlhale seka la kwalwa mo direkotong.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Rahisetori wa Mogerika e bong Strabo moragonyana o ne a kwala ka leina leo, ke ka moo re le itseng gompieno. Tempele e ne ya senngwa mo bosigong jo Alexander the Great a neng a tsholwa ka jone.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, jaaka kgosi, o ile a ithaopa go duelela kago sesha ya tempele, mme boithaopi jwa gagwe ga bo aka jwa dumelwa. Moragonyana, ga gore Alexander a tlhokafale, tempele e ile ya agiwa sesha kwa ngwaga ya 323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Netefatsa go re letsogo la ga go le repile ka moo go ka kgonagalang fa o ntse o tobetsa dikonopo ka tsela e e siameng - gape o leke go re o seka wa dira motshikinyego o o kgethegileng ka menwana ya ga go.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ka mokgwa ono, o tla itapisa go se kae fela. Gakologelwa gore ga go tlhokege go tobetsa dikonopo ka maatla a magolo gore go utlwale modumo o mogolwane jaaka mo pianong.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Mo korosetineng, go bona modumo o mogolwane, o dirisa kgatelelo kgotsa lebelo le legolwane mo meubeng.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Masaitseweng ke go sala morago botshelo ka, boitshupo ka, kgotsa go nna le kelotlhoko ya mo moweng ya dilo tse di diragalang, bomodimo, mowa wa nnete, kgotsa Modimo.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Modumedi o batlana le maitemogelo ka tlhamalalo, tlhobaelo, kgotsa kitso ya boammaruri ja bomodimo/modimo wa medimo.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Balatedi ba sala morago ditsela tse di rileng tsa go tshela, kgotsa ditwaelo tse di ikaeletseng go otla maitemogelo ao.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Tumelo ya Masaitseweng e ka farologanngwa le mefuteng e mengwe ya ditumelo tsa sedumedi le kobamelo ka e remeletse mo maitemogelo a namana a maemo a a kgethegileng a menagano, segolobogolo go bao ba ba nang le kagiso, kitso, boitumelo, kgotsa batsayakarolo ba ba itumetseng thata.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Bo-Sikhi ke tumelo e e tswang kwa nageng ya seka-kontinente ya India. E simologile kwa kgaolong ya Punjab mo lekgolong la bo-15 la dingwaga go tswa mo kgaoganong ya makoko mo setsong sa ba-Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ba-Sikh ba tsaya tumelo ya bone e le bodumedi jo bo aroganeng le Sehindu le fa gone ba dumela go re e theilwe mo Sehindung le ditlwaelo tsa yone.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Ba-Sikh ba bitsa tumelo ya bone ba re ke Gurmat, e leng "tsela ya morutisi wa sedumedi" ka se-Punjab. Borutisi jwa sedumedi ke karolo ya botlhokwa thata mo ditumelong tsotlhe tsa Se-India mme go ya ka bo-Sikhik bo tsere karolo ya botlhokwa e e bopang dithuto tsa bodumedi tsa konokono tsa ma-Sikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Tumelo e ne e simolotswe ke Guru Nanak (1469-1539) ka paka ya bolesome le botlhano. E be a salwa morago ke ke diguru tse dingwe tse di borobabongwe.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, ka Seetebosigo 1956, ditshepiso tsa ga Krushchev di ne di tsa lekwa go bona go re a di tla diragala fa dikhuduego kwa Poland, koo go gwanta ga badiri kgatlhanong le go tlhaela ga dijo le go fokodiwa ga dituelo, go ile ga fetoga go nna megwanto ka kakaretso ya go nna kgatlhanong le mmuso wa Bokomonisi.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Le fa gone kwa bofelong, Krushchev a ne a romela masole go busetsa tolamo, o ne a dumela dilo dingwe tse ba neng ba di batla tsa itsholelo mme a dumela go tlhoma Wladyslaw Gomulka yo o ratiwang go nna tonakgolo e ncha.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Tlhabologo ya Molatswana wa Indus e ne e le tlhabologo e ya Bronze Age kwa bokone-bophirima jwa seka-kontinente ya India, go akaretsa bontsi jwa naga ya Pakistan le dikgaolwana tse dintsi kwa bokone-bophirima jwa India le bokone-botlhaba jwa Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ditlhabologo di ile tsa iponatsha sentle kwa matshitshing a Noka ya Indus, moo e boning leina la yone teng.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Le fa baithuti bangwe ba fopholetsa go re e re ka tlhabologo gape e ne e le teng mo boalong jwa Noka ya Sarasvati e ga jaana e kgadileng, e tshwanetse ka tshwanelo ya bidiwa Tlhabologo ya Indus-Sarasvati, fa bangwe ba e bitsa Tlhabologo ya Harappan morago ga Harappa, lefelo la yone la ntlha go epiwa ka bo1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Dikgoka tsa mmusomogolo wa Roma di thusitse go tlhabolola boitseanape ja kalafi.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Kgosikgolo Augustus o ne a simolola go thapa dingaka mme tsa tlhama Ditlhopha tsa Kalafi ya Roma tsa ntlha, go dirisiwa morago ga ditlhabano.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Dingaka tse di arang di ne di na le kitso ka diokobatsi tse di farologaneng go akaretsa morphine go tswa mo dithotseng tsa poppy le scopolamine go tswa mo dithotseng tsa herbane.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ba ne ba nna ditswerere tsa bokgaoladirwe go pholosa balwetse ba dintho tse di kekelang ga mmogo le dithibela tatlhegelo ya madi le go kganela ditshika go thibela kelelo ya madi.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami ya Pureland e na le go re ga go letlelesege go mena pampiri makgetho a feta bongwe ka nako, e bile memeno e e matswakabele ga e letlelelwe; memeno yotlhe e tshwanetse go nna fa go tlhamaletseng teng.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bana ba simolola ba sentse ba le ba nnye go lemoga ya kgethololo ka mmala le letso, se se be se ama maitsholong a bone.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Ka sekai, bana ba ba iponang ba le maloko a morafe o go dumelwang go re ga o dire sentle kwa sekolong, le bone ba tshabelelwa ke go sa direng sentle ga ba sena go itse go re go dumelwa morafe wa bone o palelwa ke dithuto.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Diwebosaete tseno di ile tsa ngoka kgatlhego e ntsi tota, segolobogolo mo lephateng la tsa thuto.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Go na le dilo tse di nang le mosola mo diwebosaeteng tseno, tse di akaretsang, go kgona go rulaganya tsebe ya phaposi bonolo fela e e ka akaretsang di-blog, dibidio, dinepe le dipopego tse dingwe.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Tsebe eno ya inthanete e letlelesega bonolo ka go fana ka aterese e le nngwe ya webosate, seo se dira gore go nne bonolo go gopola ebile go nne bonolo gore baithuti ba ba nang le bothata le go dirisa khiiboto kgotsa le mopeleto ba tlanye.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: E ka kgona go tshwanedisiwa go dira go re go nne motlhofo go bala gape le ka mmala o o tlhokiwang o o montsi kgotsa o monnye ka moo go kgonegang.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Attention Deficit Disorder "ke botlhoko jwa tlhaloganyo jo bo tlhalosiwang bo na le dikai tse tharo tse di akaretsang go phamoga, go palela ke go tlhoma mogopolo, le matlhagatlhaga a a feteletseng kgotsa maatla a a feteletseng".
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ga se bojole ja go palelwa ke ithuta, ke bothata ja go ithuta. Bo ama bana ba ka nna bararo go ya botlhanong mo lekgolong; gongwe ebile bana baka nna didikadike di le pedi mo Amerika.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Bana ba ba nang le bolwetse jwa ADD ba na le bothata jwa go dira tiro ya sekolo, mme ba kgona go dira dilo tse bone ba di ratang thata jaaka go tshameka kana go lebelela dipopae tse ba di ratang thata; kgotsa go kwala kwa ntle ga go dirisa matshwao a mokwalo.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Bana ba ba tshabelelwa kego tsena mo mathateng ka gore ba ”inaakanya le ditiro tsedi borai jaaka, go lwantshana le batho lego lwantshana le bogogi”, gore ba tsose boboko ka gore maboko a bone ga a tsosiwe ke dilo tsa tlwaelesego.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD e ama dikamano le balekane ba bangwe ka go nne bana ba bangwe ga ba tlhaloganye go re ke eng fa ba itshwere ka tsela e ba itshwereng ka yone kgotsa ke eng fa ba peleta ka mokgwa o ba peletang ka one kgotsa go re selekanyo sa bone sa go gola sentle se farologane.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Jaaka bokgoni jwa go amogela kitso le go ithuta bo fetogile ka moo go umakilweng fa godimo ga selekanyo sa serepodi go ya ka moo kitso e bonweng e fetogile ka teng.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Tsela ya go iponela tshedimosetso e ne e farologane. Kgatelelo ga ya ka ya tlhola e le ya motho a le nosi ya go gakologelwa, mme go kgona go gakologelwa molaetsa e ne ya nna selo sa konokono.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Totatota, motlha wa tlhabologo o fetotse ka fa re ithutatang ka teng le ka fa re anamisang kitso ka teng.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Go farologana le ditshedi tse dingwe, di-hominid ga tlhole di dirisa matsogo a tsone go tsamaya kana go tsholetsa bokete kgotsa go tlolela mo ditlhareng.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
