eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Dichaba ka bontsi di bua puo ya sekgowa sentle thata, mme e bile go fitlhelwa thata go tlhoka kitso go ko tlase thata - bogolo jang thata mo bananeng.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Akanya fela, motho wa Manchester, wa Boston, wa Jamaica le wa Sydney ba ntse mmogo fa tafoleng, ba ja, mo marekisetsong a dijo kwa Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ba jesana monate ka dipolelo tsa ko ba tlholegang teng, tse ba di bolelang ka diteme tsa bone.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ga ntsi go reka dijo mo marekisetsong ke tsela e e sa lopeng madi a mantsi ya go bona dijo. Le fa go ntse jalo, ntle le sebaka sa go apaya, o ka ikaega ka dijo tse di apeetsweng ruri.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Marekisetso a simolotse go oketsa le go kabakanya dijo tse di apeetsweng ruri. Dingwe tsa tsone e bile di na le di-microwave le methale e mengwe ya go thuthafatsa dijo.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Mafatshe mangwe kgotsa mabenkele a a haphegileng a na le marekisetso a dijo gautshwanyane, go le ga ntsi e le a a iketlileng e bile dijo tsa teng di sa ture.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Dira le go tsamaya ka dikhopi tsa pholisi ya gago le dintlha tsa go ikgolaganya le rainshorense wa gago.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ba tlhoka go supa e-mail address le dinomoro tse di tswelang kwa ntle tsa khamphani ya inshorense go gakolola/rebola le go kopa thuso.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: O netefatse go re o na le mokwalo o mongwe gaufi le mo mafaratlhatlheng a enthanete (o ithomelele meriti ya tsone ka e-mail, kgotsa o di boloke mo khomputareng).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Fa o tsamaya ka lepothopo kgotsa mogala wa letheka wa sefatlhego se se tona, boloka dikhopi mo memoring wa yone kgotsa disike (e kgona go dirisiwa go se na inthanete).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Gape o fe ba o tsamayang nabo kgotsa ba masika le ditsala kwa gae fa ba eletsa go thusa meriti ya ga go ya inshorense/kwa ba ka tshwarwang teng.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Phologolo e e bidiwang moose (e gape e itseweng ka leina la elk) ga e bogale, le fa gone iphemela fa e dumela e gomagomediwa botshelo.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Fa batho basa lemoge go re phologolo ya moose e ka nna borai, ba ka e atamela ba se kelotlhoko, ka jalo baya matshelo a bone mo diphatseng.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Nwang bojalwa ka tekanyetso. Bojalwa bo ama mongwe le mongwe ka tsela tse di sa tshwaneng, go itse selekanyo sa gago go botlhokwa.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Kgonagalo ya ditiragalo tsa nako e telele tsa botsogo tse di bakwang ke go nwa nnotagi phetelela di ka akaretsa go senyega ga sebete le e leng bofofu le loso. Kotsi e e ka nnang gone e a okediwa ke fa o nwa bojalwa jo bo dirwang ka tsela e e sa letlelesegang ka fa molaong.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Dinotagi tse di seng mo molaong di na le dikhemikhale tse di kotsi jaaka methanol, e e ka tlholang bofofu kgotsa loso le fa e ka nna e nnyane fela.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Digalase tsa matlho kwa dinageng di sele di kgona go nna tlhwatlhwa-tlase, segolo jang kwa dinageng tse di duelang lotseno lo lo nnye koo ditshenyegelo tsa badiri di leng kwa tlase.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Akanyetsa go tlhatlhobelwa matlho kwa lapeng, bogolo jang fa o na le itshireletso ya bongaka, o bo o tla le lekwalo la ngaka la melemo go re le bolokiwe go sele.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Diforeime tsa maemo fa di bonala mo mafelonga a ntseng jalo go ka nna le mathata a mabedi ; ga se tsa nnete, gape tsa nnete di tura go feta kwa di tswang gone.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kofi ke nngwe ya dikuno tse di rekisiwang thata mo lefatsheng, mme oka bona mefuta e e farologaneng ya kofi mo lefelong le o dulang mo go lona.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, go na le methale e mentsi e e farologanyeng ya go nwa kofi mo lefatsheng, e motho a ka batlang go e itemogela.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Lefoko "canyoning" (kgotsa canyoneering) go akaretsa go tsamaela kwa tlase ga borotelatsweneng, bo bo ka tswang bo phaphaletse kgotsa bo tletse metsi.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Go akaretsa gape go thuma, go palamela le go tlola - mo go sa tlhokeng go itshidila mmele go go ipaakanyetsa (fa go tshwantshanngwa le go palama matlapa, scuba diving kgotsa alpine skiing).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Go pagama dithaba ke nngwe ya dilo tse o direlang kwa ntle tse di akaretsang go tsamaya mo ditikologong tsa tlhago, go le ga ntsi mo ditselaneng tsa teng.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Go haeka go akaretsa sekgala se se kwa tlase ga mmaele go ya go sekgala se se leele se se ka dirwang mo letsatsing le le nosi.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Go palama dithaba ga letsatsi le le lengwe, ga go tlhoke gore motho a ipaakanye thata, ebile mongwe le mongwe a ka kgona a itumelela se.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Malapa a a nang le bana ba ba nnye a ka tlhoka dipaakanyo tse di oketsegileng, mme go nna letsatsi kwa ntle go kgonega motlhofo le e leng ka masea le bana ba khereche.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Mo lefatsheng lotlhe, go na le mekgatlho e le 200 e e dirang tiro ya go bontsha bajanala lefelo. Bontsi jwa yone bo ikemetse ka nosi.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Motlhatlhami wa Globala Running Tours, Go Running Tours o golaganya ditlhopha di le lesome-le-bobedi tsa batlamedi ba batabogi ba lefelo mo dikontinenteng di le nne.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: E simolotse e le Barcelona Running Tours ya ko Barcelona, le Copenhagen Running ya Copenhagen, mme ka bofefo ya kopana le Running Tours Prague ya ko Prague, le tse dingwe.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Go na le dilo tse dintsi tse o tshwanetseng go di akanyetsa pele le ka nako ya fa o ya felo gongwe.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Fa o tsaya leeto, solofela go re dilo di ka se tshwane le ka fa di leng ka teng kwa "gae ko o tswang teng". Maitseo, melao, dijo, pharakano, manno, maemo, puo jalo le jalo go ya bokgakaleng jo bo rileng di tla fapaana le kwa o dulang teng.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Se ke sengwe sa dilo tse o tshwanetseng wa nna o di gopotsa, go tila go swabisiwa kgotsa gongwe le e leng go tlhoa tsela ya selegae e go dirwang dilo ka yone.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Boemedi jwa tsa bojanala di tswa kgakala fa e sale ka dingwaga tsa bo 19. Moemedi wa tsa Mesepele gantsi o neela baeti dikgakololo tse di fetang maitemogelo a a fetileng a moeti ka ga tlhago, setso, puo kgotsa dinaga tsa lotseno lo lo kwa tlase.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Le fa bontsi jwa ditheo di iketleeditse go tsaya bontsi jwa dipeeletso tsa ka metlha, badiredi le bantsi ba ke dikgeleke mo mefuteng e e rileng ya mosepele, madi a a lekanyeditsweng kgotsa mafelo a go jwang kwa go one.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Go ka nna botoka go dirisa modiredi yo kgapetsakgapetsa a dirang dipeeletso tse di tshwanang tsa mesepele.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Lebelela go re ke mesepele efe e modiredi a e rotloetsang, e ka tswa e le mo webosaeteng kgotsa mo letlhabaphefong la lebenkele.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Fa o batla go bona lefatshe ka tlhwatlhwa e e ko tlase, e le ka letlhoko kgotsa monate wa botshelo kgotsa dikgwetlho, go na le mokgwawa go dira jalo.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Tota, go ga bedi: Ke go theogela o ntse o le mo loetong kgotsa go leka go fokotsa tiriso ya madi. Mokwalo o, o itebagantse le ntlha ya bofelo.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Ba ba ikemiseditseng go latlhegelwa ke manobononobo, nako le tebelopele go re ba fokotse tshenyegelo ya madi, ba lebe "minimum budget travel".
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Go tseelwa go re batsamai ga ba utswe, go tsena fela ba sena tetla, go tsaya karolo mo mmarakeng kwa ntle ga molao, go kopa, kgotsa go tshwara ba bangwe makgwakgwa ka ntlha ya go ipoonela sengwe.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Fa o fologa sefofane, sekepe kgotsa koloi, ga ntsi o simolola ka go ema fa ba taolo-mesepele ba tlhodumetsang matlho mo dithotong tsa ga go.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Mo ditereneng dingwe tse di kgabaganyang melelwane ditlhatlhobo di dirwa mo tereneng e ntse e tsamaya mme o tshwanetse wa nna le boitshupo jo bo siameng mo go wena fa o palama nngwe ya diterena tseo.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Mo ditereneng tsa bosigo, dibukana tsa mesepele di ka tsewa ke babereki ba terena go itsa go kgaupetsa bapalami boroko.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ikwadiso ke nngwe ya ditlhokego fa o ikwadisetsa setlankana sa go etela naga e nngwe. Kwa dinageng tse dingwe, o tshwanetse go kwadisa aterese ya kwa o nnang, le go re o tla bo o nna kae fa o etile.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Se se ka nna sa batla gore o tlatse foromo le mapodisa a a mo tikologong kana o etele ba lephata la tsa mesepele.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Mo dinageng tse di ntsi tse di nang le molao o o ntseng jalo, dihotele tse di mo tikologong ke tsone tse di dirang ikwadiso. (Tlhomamisa gore o a botsa).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Fa gongwe, ba ba nnang kwa ntle ga mafelo a bojanala ke bone fela ba ba tshwanetseng go ikwala. Mme le gale, se se dira go re molao o seka wa tlhaloganyesega sentle, ka jalo, o tla tshwanelwa ke go botsolotsa nako e sale teng.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Architecture e amana le dipopo le go aga dikago. Architecture ya lefelo gantsi e kgona go ngoka bajanala ka bo yone.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Dikago tse dintsi di dintle go lejwa, gape go lebelela o le mo kagong e telele kgotsa e beilwe mo maemong a a siameng, go go ntle fela thata.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Architecture e tsamaisana le ditiro tse dingwe go akaretsa le go rulaganyetsa metse-setoropo, boenjenere ja kago, kgabisong botsweretshi, tiro ya kgabiso ya boteng ya matlo le tikologo ya one.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Re lebile ka fa bontsi jwa metsana e e leng kgakala ka teng, o ka sokolela go bona maitiso a a kgotsofatsang fa o ka se tsamaele ko Albuquerque kgotsa Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, bontsi ja mafelo a itloso boduto a di casino a a umakilweng fa godimo, a rekisa bojalwa; e bile mangwe mo go one a dirisa didirisiwa tsa maina a a tumileng go natefisa maitiso (bogolo jang mo go tse di tona tse di gaufi le Albuquerque le Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Ela Tlhoko: dibara tsa ditoropo tse dinnye mono di kgona go sa nneng mafelo a a siametseng moeng o o tswang go sele.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Se se le teng ke go re bokone jwa Mexico botshabelelwa ke go nna le bakgweetsi ba ba itshietseng nnotagi, bontsi ja bone ba le gaufi le dibara tsa metsana e mennye.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Mokwalo le ditshwantsho tse di mo maboteng, tse di sa batliweng, di bidiwa graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Le fa e se sengwe sa se segompieno, batho ka bontsi ba ka tswa ba e amanya le basha fa ba senya didiriswa tsa botlhe le tsa poraefete ka go dirisa pente ya seporei.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, matsatsing a go na le bataki ba mekwalokwalo ya mabota, mekete ya mekwalokwalo ya mabota le ”mabota a a mo molaong”. Mekwalokwalo ya mabota e ntseng jaana, ka dinako tse dingwe e tsewa jaaka botaki jo e seng tshenyo,
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Go latlhela Boomerang ke bokgoni jo bo rategang jo baeti ba le bantsi ba ka ratang go nna le jone.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Fa o batla go ithuta go konopa bomareng e e boelang ko letsogong la gago, tlhomamisa gore ona le bomareng ee siametseng go boela letsogong.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Bontsi jwa di-boomerang tse di leng teng kwa Australia tota tota ga setse di bowang. Go botoka thata go re ba ba simololang ba seka ba leka go latlhela fa go le diphefo.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Dijo tsa Hangi di apeelwa mo khuting e e bolelo mo mmung.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Khuti e gotediwa ka maje a molelo a a tswang mo molelong, kgotsa mo mafelong mangwe metswedi e e pumpunyegang ka mogote e dira go re mafelo a a mo mmung a nne mogote ka tlhago.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Khuthi gantsi e dirisetswa go apaya dijo tsa setso tsa maitsiboa.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Mafelo a a farologaneng kwa Rotorua a na le hangi ya metswedi e e pumpunyegang ka mogote, fa hangi e nngwe e ka lekelediwa mo Christchurch, Wellington le kwa mafelong a mangwe.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail e na le mefuta e le mebedi ya terena mo teng go dikologa Cape Town: MetroPlus (e gape e bidiwang ya Maemo a Ntlha) le Metro (e e bidiwang ya Maemo a Boraro).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Ke itumeletse Metroplus e bile gape ga e a tlala mme tlhwatlhwa ya yone e kwa godimonyana go se nene, le fa ntswa e le ko tlase go gaisa ditekete tse di tlwaelegileng kwa Yuropa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Diterena tsotlhe di na le matoroko a ka bobedi MetroPlus le Metro; a MetroPlus a nna a le ko morago ga terena e e gaufi le Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Go tshwarela batho dilwana - O se ka wa tsamaya wa kgaogana le dibeke tsa ga go, bogolo jang fa o kgabaganya melolwane.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: O ka nna wa iphitlhela o dirisitswe go rwala ditagi o sa itse, mme seo se ka go tsenya mo mathateng a a seng kana ka sepe.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Se se akaretsa go fola laene, ka jaana dintsa tse di dirisiwang go dupa ditagi di ka diriswa nako nngwe le nngwe ntle le tsiboso.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Mafatshe mangwe a dirisa dikotlhao tse setlhogo phetelela le e le la ntlha motho a dirile molato ; e kgona go akaretsa katlholelo dingwaga tse 10 mo kgolegelong kgotsa loso.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Dibeke tse di sa tlhokomelwang di ke tsone tse di utswiwang motlhofo; ebile di kgona go belaetsa baokamedi ba lefelo bogolo thata jang fa go kile ga nna le matshosetsi a dibomo.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Kwa gae, ka go bo o rakana le megare ya ko o go tswang, masole a mmele wa ga go a ka tswa a tiile mo e ka go tsenyeng bolwetsi.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Mme mo mafelong a mangwe mo lefatsheng ka bophara, ko mogareng wa bacteriological fauna o leng mosha mo go wena, o nale tshono e ntsha ya go tsena mo mathateng.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Gape, kwa mafatsheng a a bothitho megare e gola ka bofefo e bile e tshela lebaka le le leele kwa ntle ga mmele.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Ke gone ka moo go nang le digajaja tsa letsholo la Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, le tse dingwe tse dintsi tse di tsamaelanang natso.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Fela jaaka malwetsi a mafatlha mo mafelong a a tsididi, malwetsi a mala a tlwaelesegile mo mafelong a a molelo mme go le ga ntsi a tena mme a se diphatsa mo go kalo.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Fa ele gore o etelela lefatshe le le tlhabologiang lekgetlho lantlha – kana lefelo le lesha la lefatshe – o seka wa nyatsa kgonagalo ya gore o tlile go makatswa ke mokgwa o ba dirang dilo ka teng.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Bontsi jwa bajanala ba mashetla ebile ba itshetlhetse, ba paletswe ke emelana le ditlhabololo tse di ntsi tse di sha mo mhameng wa go sepela lefatshe, fa go re go nna o itlwaetsa dingwao tse disha tse di ntsi go a ba fekeetsa.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Thata thata mo malatsing a ga go a ntlha, sekaseka go itshwina mo dioteleng tsa mafatshe a a tlhabologileng tsa maemo a a kwa godimo, dijo, le ditirelo go itlwaetsa botshelo joo.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: O seka wa robala mo materaseng ha hatshe fatshe kwa mafelong a o sa itseng diphologolo tsa one.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Fa o ikaelela go ya go kampa, o itlele bolawana jo bo dirisiwang kwa dikampeng kgotsa letloa le le gokelwang mo ditlhareng go tshaba dinoga, diphepheng le tsone jalo jalo.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Tlatsa legae la gago ka kofi e e lobebe mo mosong le ka tee e e lapolosang ya chamomile bosigo.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Fa o na le tshono ya go nna o le nosi, o na le nako ya go ithentha e bile o ka dirisa metsotso e e oketsegileng go ititielela sengwe se se monate.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Fa o ikutlwa o ka lekeletsa dilo le go feta, dirisa tshono eno itirela juse kgotsa go ritela smoothy.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Gongwe o tla bona seno se o tla phakelang o se nwa mo mosong fa o boela mo thulaganyong ya gago ya letsatsi le letsatsi.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Fa o nna mo toropong e e nang le mekgwa e e farologaneng ya go nwa bojalwa, ikele kwa bareng kgotsa phapo e e fa gaufi e o se keng o ya ko go yone kgapetsa.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Mo go bao ba sa tlwaelanang le mafoko a a itsiweng fela ke ba bongaka, mafoko tshwaetso le tshelana a na le bokao jo bo a farologanyang.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Bolwetsi jo bo tshelanwang bo bakiwa ke ditshidinyana jaaka megare, mothuthuntshwane kgotsa megare e mengwe.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Bolwetse jo bo tshelanwang ke bolwetse jo bo fetelang motlhofo fela ka go bo o le mo lefelong le lengwe le motho yo o tshwaetsegileng.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Bontsi jwa dipuso di tlhoka go re baeti ba ba gorogang, kgotsa baagi ba ba tswang ka naga ya bone, ba entelwe kgatlhanong le malwetse a a farologaneng.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Ditlhokafalo tseno ga ntsi di ka ikaega ka se dinaga tse motsamai a di etetseng kgotsa a ikaeletseng go di etela.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Sengwe sa dilo tse di dirang go re lefelo la Charlotte kwa North Carolina le bo le le botoka thata, ke go bo le na le mafelo a maemo a a kwa godimo a le mantsi a kwa go one batho ba lelwapa lotlhe ba ka ijesang monate.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Go le ga ntsi banni ba mafelo a mangwe ba kaya fa go bo lefelo leo le siametse malwapa e le lebaka la kokono le le dirileng go re ba hudugele koo, mme le ba ba jelang nala teng ba bona go le motlhofo go le akola le bana ba le teng.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Mo dingwageng tse di masome a Mabedi tse di fetileng, palo ya tsamaiso e e amogelang maikutlo a bana ko Uptown Charlotte e godile ka palo e e kgatlhisang e e ko godimo.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ga se ga ntsi ba malapa a Charlotte ba dirisa ditekisi, le fa gone di le mosola mo mabakeng a a rileng.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Go na le tuelo ya tlaleletso fa bapagami ba feta 2, ka jalo jaana go tura go feta selekanyo.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica ke lefelo le le tsididi go gaisa mo Lefatsheng. Le dikologile South Pole.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Maeto a bojanala a tlhwatlhwa godimo, a tlhoka boitekanelo mo mmeleng, e bile go ka etiwa fela ka selemo mo kgweding tsa Ngwanatsele go fitlha go Tlhakole, e bile ga ntsi a felela fela mo pheninsulareng, le tlhaketlhake, le Lewatle la Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Go na le badiri ba ba ka tshwarang dikete tse pedi, ba ba nnang teng ka paka ya selemo, mo metsaneng e e ka nnamng masome a matlhano a a mo mafelong ao; ba le palo potlana ba tswelela ba nna teng le go le mariga.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Boteng jwa Antarctica ke setlhaba se se senang sepe, se aperwe ke metsi a a gatsetseng, a a boteng jwa dikhilomithara tse gareng ga 2 le 3.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Go a tle go nne le maeto a bojanala a difofane a a tsenelelang mo bogareng, go ya go palama dithaba kgotsa go goroga ko South Pole - kwa go nang le motsana o mogolwanyane teng.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (kgotsa Tselakgolo) ke tsela ya dikhilomithara di le 1600, e e tswang kwa McMurdo Station ka kwa lewatleng la Ross, e goroga kwa South Pole.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ke kapoko e e gatisitsweng le diphatlha tse di katetsweng le go tshwaiwa ka difolaga. Go ka tsamaya diterekere tse di kgethegileng fela, di goga selei sa leokwane le ditlamelo.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Ga se motsamo o o bonolo, se se raya gore tsela ya teng e dikologa dithaba go fitlhela ko phitlhelelong.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Se se sebakang dikotsi thata mo marigeng ke ditsela tse di reledisang, ditselana tse di riteletsweng (tse di fa thoko ga tsela) le segolobogolo, disetepise.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Le fa go twe go padile, o tlhokana le ditlhako tse di nang le bogato jo bo siameng. Ditlhako tsa selemo ga ntsi di a relela mo godimo ga metsi a a gatsetseng le sefako, le tsone ditlhako tse dingwe tsa mariga ga di a siama.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Tomagano ya gona e tshwanetse go nna boteng, 5mm (1/5 inch) kgotsa go feta, le kgatiso e tshwanetse go nna boleta thata mo maemong a bosa a tsididi).
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ditlhako tse dingwe di na le dikhokho, gape go na le didiriswa tse di ka tshwarisiwang mo ditlhakong tsa mefuta e e farologanyeng ka bontsi.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Dikweekwee di tshwanetse go nna ko tlase di le bophara. Mmu, matlapana kana letswai (calcium chloride) ga ntsi di gasame gotlhe mo ditseleng kgotsa ditselana go tokafatsa tsamao.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Di-avalanche ke dilo tsa tlholego; go na le seelo sa selekanyo sa kapoko se se kgonang go nna mo letlhakoreng la thaba. Ga kapoko e nna ntsi thata, e nngwe e kgokologa le thaba e le avalanche.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Bothata ke gore kapoko e a kgomarela, ka jalo e tlhoka go isiwa kwa tlase, mme go wa ga kapoko go ka baka tiragalo e nngwe ya tse dintsi.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ka nako tse dingwe tiragalo ya ntlha e e gakgamatsang ke fa letsatsi le gotetsa sefako, ka nako tse dingwe go wa ga sefako se se oketsegileng, ka nako tse dingwe ditiragalo tsa tlhago, ga ntsi batho.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Kgwanyape ke tikoloso ya phefo ya kgatelelo e e ko tlase, e e gopang moya o o mo tikologong e o gopela mo teng le kwa godimo.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Di dira diphefo tse di bogale (ga ntsi 100-200 ya dimmaele ka ura) mme di kgona go tsholeletsa dilo tse di bokete mo moweng, di di tsholetsa jaaka kgwanyape e ntse e tsamaya.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Di simolola pele e le diphatlhanyana tse di fologang go tswa mo marung a setsuatsue, mme di bo di nna "kgwanyape" fa di kgoma mmu.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Batlamedi ba di-VPN (virtual private network) tse di sa tlhakanelwang ke bone ba ba siametseng go dirisiwa fa o batla go tila dikganelelo tse di bewang ke mapolitiki le bagwebi ba ba lekang go bona go re motho yo dirisang enthanete o a bo a le kae.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ke tsa boleng jo bo kwa godimo go gaisa go ne le dikemedi tsa webo ka ntlha ya mabaka a le mmalwa: Di kaela go sele pharakano yotlhe ya inthanete, e seng fela http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Gantsi di neelana ka makhubu a a kwa godimo le tirelo ya boleng jo bo botoka. Di sireletsegile thata ka jalo go thata go re o ka di bonela.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Dikomponi tsa metswedi ya tshedimosetso ga di bue nnete gangwe le gape ka boikaelelo jwa seno, ba bolela fa e le tsela ya go "thibela bokgothusi".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Tota e bile, dikhoutu tsa lefelo ga di na thuse ka sepe mo ditirong go kopolola mo go seng ka fa molaong; kopololo ya biti-ka-biti ya disike e tla tshameka sentle fela mo sedirisweng sepe fela se ya ntlha e ka tshamekang mo go sone.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Boikaelelo tota tota ke go naya dikhampani tseo taolo e e oketsegileng mo mebarakeng ya tsone; ke kgang ya go dira lotseno.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ka gore megala e mo maharathatheng a enthanete, ga go tlhokege go re o dirise mogala wa setlamo sa kwa o nnang teng kgotsa kwa o etelang teng.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Gape ga go tlhokagale go re o nne le nomore ya selegae go tswa mo motseng o o nnang mo go one; o ka kgona go nna le nomore ya go gokelelwa mo sathalaeteng ya intanete kwa dikgweng tsa Chicken, Alaska mme o tlhophe nomore e e supang fa o le kwa Arizonia e e letsatsi.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Gantsi, o tshwanelwa ke go reka nomore ya lefatshe lotlhe kwa thoko e e letlang go re megala PSTN e go leletse. Koo nomore e tswang teng ke gone go dirang pharologano mo bathong ba ba go leletsang.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Ditiriso tsa thanolo ya mafoko tse di direlang ka bonako - ditiriso tse di kgonang go ranola seele sotlhe jaaka sentse ka itiriso go tswa mo puong e nngwe go ya go e nngwe.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Dingwe tsa ditiriso tse di mo setlhopheng seno di kgona le e leng go ranola mafoko a dipuo tsa dinaga di sele mo matshwaong kgotsa dilwana tse dingwe mo lefatsheng la mmatota fa modirisi a supa dilo tseo ka mogala wa gagwe wa letheka.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Dienjene tsa thanolo di tokafaditswe ka selekanyo se se kwa godimo tota, mme jaanong ga ntsi di neelana ka bontsi kgotsa bobotlana dithanolo tse di siameng (mme ke ka sewelo di neelang thanolo e sa utlwaleng), mme go tlhokega go re di elwe tlhoko, e re ka di santse di ka ranola ka tsela e e phoso.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Nngwe ya ditiriso tse di tlhageletseng go di gaisa mo setlhopeng seno ke Google Translate, e e go letlang go ranolela o se mo inthanete morago ga go re o laisolole tshedimosetso ya puo e o e batlang.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Go dirisa ditiriso tsa GPS tsa go supa tsela mo mogaleng wa ga go wa letheka go ka nna motlhofo e bile e le tsela e botoka le go feta ya go supa tsela fa o tswetse kwa ntle ga lefatshe la gaeno.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: E kgona go babalela madi go na le go reka di mmepe tsa GPS tse disha, kana GPS e e ikemetseng ka nosi kana go e hira kwa dikhampaning tsa go hirisa dikoloi.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Fa o sena kgolagano ya inthanete mo mogaleng wa ga go, kana fa go sena neteweke, tiragatso ya tsone e ka nna ya lekanyediwa kgotsa ya seka ya nna teng.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Mabenkele otlhe a mannye a na le tlhakantshuke ya dikarata tsa pre-paid tsa mesokelatsebeng; tse di ka dirisiwang mo mesokelatsebeng e e duelelwang, le mo go e e tswaelesigileng
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Le fa gone dikarata tse dintsi di siametse go ka letsetsa gongwe le gongwe, tse dingwe di diretswe go neelana ka dielo tse di solegelang molemo tsa go letsa tsa setlhopha se se rileng sa dinaga.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Go bona ditirelo tseno ga ntsi go ka bonwa ka tiriso ya nomore ya mogala e e sa duelelweng e e ka lelediwang e bontsi jwa megala bo kgonang go e leletsa ntle le tuelo.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Melao e e malebana le go tsaya dinepe ga ka metlha gape e dira mo go rekotiweng ga dibidio, tota le e leng go feta moo.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Fa e le go re go tsaya senepe fela ga go a letlelelwa, hee ga wa tshwanela go akanya go re bidio yone o ka e rekote.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Fa o dirisa drone, o batlisise pele ga nako gore ke eng se o letelelwang go se kapa le teseletso kana tse dingwe tse di tlhokegang.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Go fofisa drone gaufi le boemafofane kgotsa mo godimo ga batho ba le bantsi ke kakanyo e e sa siamang ka metlha, le fa go se kgatlhanong le molao mo tulong ya ga go.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Malatsing ano go tsaya leeto ka sefofane ke ka sewelo go beelediwang ka tlhamalalo kwa ditirelong tsa difofane kwa ntle ga go batla pele le go bapisa ditlhwatlhwa.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ka dinako tse dingwe sefofane se le sengwe se ka kgona go nna le ditlhwatlhwa tse di farologaneng thata kwa baemeding ba ba farologaneng mme go solegela molemo go bapisa dipholo tsa patlo le go leba webosaete ya ditirelo tsa sefofane ka boyone pele o dira peeletso.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Le fa o ka se tlhoke lekwalotetla la go etela ka boripana dinaga tse di rileng o le mojanala kana o tsile ka tsa kgwebo, go ya koo o le moithuti wa bodichabachaba ga ntsi go tlhoka go re o nne lobaka lo lo leele koo go na le go ya teng fela e kete o mojanala.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Ka kakaretso, fa o batla go nna mo lefatsheng le e seng la gaeno ka lobaka lo lo leele, o tla tshwanela ke go dira lekwalotetla la boagi nako e sale teng.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Tetlelelo ya baithuti go ya kwa dinageng tse dingwe e nale ditlhokego tse di farologaneng go tsa bajanala kgotsa bo-rrakgwebo
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Mo mafatsheng ka bontsi, go tlhokwa lekwalo le le supang go re o amogeletswe ko sekolong se o eletsang go ithuta ko go sone. Gape o tla tshwanelwa ke go ntsa sesupo sa go re o na le madi a go ituelela sekolo le go itshetsa ngwaga wa ntlha wa sekolo.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Botsisa le ba sekwele, ga mmogo le ba lephata la tsa mesepele la lefatshe le o batlang go ithutang teng, go itse sengwe le sengwe se se tlhokwang.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Kwa ntle ga fa o direla boemedi ja lefatshe, ga ntsi go bereka kwa moseja go raya go re o tla tshwanela go kwadisa lekgetho la letseno kwa nageng e o tswang kwa go yone.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Lekgetho la ”income tax” le agilwe ka ditsela tse di farologaneng mo dinageng tse di farologaneng, mme seelo sa lotseno le dituelo (tax bracket) di farologana thata go tswa mo nageng e nngwe go ya kwa go e nngwe.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Mo mafatsheng mangwe a di-federale jaaka a Amerika le Canada, seelo sa lekgetho la letseno se bewa e le sa lefatshe lotlhe, le sa dikgaolwana, jaanong ditlhwatlhwa di kgona go farologanya ka dikgaolo.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Le ntswa ba lephata ba mesepele e se ga ntsi ba phuruphutsha motho fa a boela mo lefatsheng la ga gabo, ba taolo ya dithoto bone ba kgona go wetsa dingalo.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Netefatsa go re o itse tse di letlelelwang le tse di sa letlelelweng go tsena mo lefatsheng, e bile o bege tsotlhe tse di bontsi jo bo fetang seelo se se beilweng ka fa molaong.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Tsela e e motlhofo thata ya go simolola kgwebo ya go kwala ka mesepele ke go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa ga go mo webosaeteng e e tlhomilweng ya maeto.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Morago ga gore o nne le bokgoni jwa go ipaakanyetsa le go tlhabolola mo inthaneteng, moragonyana, oka kgona go itirela webosaete e e leng ya gago.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Go ithaopa o le mo maetong ke motlhale o mongwe o mw ntle ya go dira pharologanyo; mme ga se ka go aba fela.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Go nna o bo o ithaopa mo nageng e e seng ya ga lona ke motlhale o monate wa go ka itse ka ditso tse di farologaneng, go kopana le batho ba basha, o iithuta, go leba dilo ka tsela e e farologanyeng le go ka ithuta bokgoni jo bosha.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Gape e ka nna tsela ya go somarela madi, go nna kwa lefelong le le lengwe lobaka lo le leele ka go nne ditiro tsa baithaopi ka bontsi di fa boroko e bile tse dingwe di kgona go duela dikatsonyana.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Batho ba kgaolo ya Scandanavia ba lankane ba ba itsegeng ka leina la Vikings ba ne ba tsamaya mo dinokaneng tsa Russia go goroga kwa lewatleng la Black Sea le la Caspian Sea. Dikarolwana tsa metlhala e di santse di ka dirisiwa. Tlhomamisa go re a o tlhoka teseletso e e haphegileng, e e ka tswang e se motlhofo go bonwa.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White se-Baltic Canal e golaganya Arctic ocean le Baltic Sea, e heta ka Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga le Saint Petersburg, thata ka dinoka le macha.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lecha la Onega le lone le golaganye le Volga, ka jalo o santse o kgona go tswa Caspian Sea o feta ka Russia.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Nna le tshepo ya go re fa o goroga kwa maemelong dikepe sengwe le sengwe se tla a senoga. O tla a rakana le batho ba ba kopang go pegiwa mo dikepeng mme ba tla a amogana dikitso nao.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: O tla bo o ntsha dikitsiso o naya batho thuso, o tsamaya mo maemakepeng, o atamela batho o phepafatsa dikepe tsa bone, o leka go golagana le batsamaisasekepe mo bareng, jalo le jalo.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Leka go bua le batho ba bantsi ka moo go kgonagalang. Morago ga sebaka mongwe le mongwe otla go itse aba a gofa lesedi la gore ke sekepe sefeng se se batlang mongwe.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: O tshwanetse wa tlhopha sefofane sa ga go sa Frequent Flyer ka kelotlhoko.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Mme fela le fa o nagana gore go botlhale go tsenela lekgatho la difofane tse o di fofisang gantsi, o tshwanetse o ele tlhoko gore ditshiamelo tse di neelwang gantsi ga di tshwane e bile dituelo tse ba go fang tsone di ka tswa di tlhatswapelo ka fa tlase ga difofane tsa dikgolagano tse dingwe.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Difofane tse di tshwanang le bo Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines di okeditse ditirelo tsa tsone ko Aforika, e bile di neelana ka dikgokagano go ya ditoropong tse dintsi tse dikgolo tsa Aforika ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di siameng go na le difofane tsa Yuropa.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Difofane tsa kwa Turkish Airlines di fofela mafelong a le 39 mo dinageng tse 30 tsa Aforika fa e sale ka 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Fa o na le nako e e oketsegileng ya go tsamaya, tlhola go bona gore palogotlhe ya madi a go ya Afrika ke bokae fa o e bapisa le madi a go ralala lefatshe.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: O seka wa lebala go tsenyeletsa ditshenyegelelo tse di okeditsweng ke dibukana tse dingwe tsa mesepele, makgetho a mesepele, sepalamo jalo jalo. gotlhe ko go etelwang teng ko ntle ga Afrika.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Fa o batla go fofa go dikologa Lefatshe lotlhe ka fa Sephatlong sa Borwa fela, maitlhophelo a ga go a difofane le mafelo ga a kalokalo, ka ntlha ya tlhaelo ya ditsela tse di ralalang mawatle.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ga gona kgolagano epe ya difofane e e fetang mo makgabaganyong otlhe ka boraro a a mo Sephatlong sa Borwa (e bile SkyTeam ga se fete mo go lepe).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Mme gone, Star Alliance e tsamaya gotlhe kwa ntle ga botlhaba jwa Borwa jwa Pacific go tswa kwa Santiago de Chile go ya kwa Tahiti, e e leng sefofane sa LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: O ka nna wa se dirise sefofane se fa o sa batle go ralala mafelo a a kwa borwa jwa lewatle la Pacific le a a mo letshitshing le le kwa bophirima ba Amerika o o borwa.(bona kwa tlase)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ka 1994, kgaolo ya Nagorno-Karabakh, ya batho ba letso la se-Armenia, mo lefatsheng la Azerbaijan, e ne ya bolotsa ntlwa kgatlhanong le batho ba letso la se-Azeri.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ka tshegetso ya ba Armenia, go ne ga tlhangwa lefatshe le lesha, mme fela fela ga se lefatshe le letseewang tsiya ke mafatshe a mangwe le la Armenia tota.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Dingangisano tsa sepolitiki kaga kgaolo di tsweletse ka go goga goga mo seretseng dikamano tsa magareng ga Armenia le Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Kgaolo ya Canal (e e bidiwang Grachtengordel ka se-Dutch) ke kgaolo e e tumileng ya dingwageng tsa makgolo a 17, e e dikologileng Binnenstad mo Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Kgaolo yotlhe e beetswe thoko go nna Lefelo la Ngwao la Lefatshe la UNESCO ka ntlha ya setso se se kgethegileng le boleng jwa ditso, e bile ditlhwatlhwa tsa ditsha teng ke dingwe tsa tse di kwa godimo ga gaisa mo nageng.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Clique Terra, mo go rayang Mafelo a Matlhano, ke metsana e metlhano e e mo letshitshing la lewatle ya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza le Monterosso, mo kgaolong ya Ithali ya Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: A tlhagelela mo lenaaneng la Mafelo a Ngwao a Lefatshe a UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Mo makgolong a dingwaga a a fetileng, batho ba ntse ba aga malapana ka manontlhotlho mo mekgokoloseng ya teng, go tsamaela fela le dithabana tse di okament letshitshi la lewatle.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Sengwe se se kgatlhisang ka ope ke go bo go se na ditlhabololo tse dintsi tsa kgwebo-kgolo. Ditselana, diterena, le mekoro di kopanya metse e, mme dikoloi ga di kgone go goroga go tswa ko ntle.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Mefuta e farologanyeng ya Sefora se se buiwang kwa Belgium le Switzerland e farologana go se nene le se se buiwang kwa France, le fa gone e na le ha e tshwanang teng mo o ka e tlhaloganyang yoo mebedi.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Segolobogolo, thulaganyo ya dinomore ya Sefora sa Belgium le Switzerland e harologana go go le gonnye le Sefora se se buiwang kwa Fora, mme le ka fa ba bitsang mafoko mangwe ka teng go farologana go le gonnye.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Le fa go ntse jalo, batho botlhe ba Belgium le Switzerland ba ithutile Sefora se se tlwaelesegileng kwa sekolong, ka jalo ba ka kgona go go tlhaloganya le fa o dirisa mokgwa o o tlwaelesegileng wa go bala ka Sefora.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Mo dintlheng di le dintsi tsa lefatshe, go laela ka letsogo ke tsela ya botsalano ya go "dumedisa."
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Mme gone, kwa Malaysia, bobotlana mo go ba letso lwa Ba-Malay kwa magaeng, go raya go re "tla kwano," go tshwana le monwana wa bosupa o lebile mo mmeleng, letshwao le le dirisiwang mo dinageng dingwe tsa Bophirima, mme le tshwanetse go dirisiwa fela jone boikaelelo joo.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ka mo go tshwanang, mosepedi wa moBorithane kwa Spain a ka dira phoso ka go akanya go re go tsholetsa letsogo fa o sadisa sentle ka seatla se lebile motho yo o go sadisang sentle, (e seng yo o sadisiwang sentle) e le sesupo sa go re boela kwano.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Dipuo tse di thusang ke dipuo tsa maitirelo kgotsa tse di itlhametsweng ka boikaelelo jwa go dira go re go nne le puisano magareng ga batho ba ka tsela nngwe ba go fitlhelang go le thata go buisana.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Di kwa thoko fa di bapisiwa le lingua francas, tse e leng tsa tlholego kgotsa dipuo tse di tshelang tse e leng tsone tse di eteletseng pele ka ntlha ya lebaka le le rileng kgotsa le sele go re go puisano e kgonagale magareng ga batho ba ba buang dipuo tse dingwe.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Mo mogoteng wa letsatsi, basepidi ba ka itemogela meuwane e e dirang go re e nne e kete o bona metsi (kgotsa dilo tse dingwe).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Se se ka nna borai fa e le go re mosepedi o latelela dilo tse di seyong, a senya maatla le metsi tse di botlhokwa thata tse di setseng.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Le sekaka sese bolelo godi feta, se kgona go nna tshididi thata mo bosigong. Go wela mogote wa mmele thata, go a kgonega fa motho a sa apara dilwana tse di bothitho.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ka selemo, segolobogolo, o tla tshwanela go tlhokomela menang fa o swetsa ka go re o batla go haeka mo dikgweng tsa pula.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Tota le e leng fa o kgweetsa sekgweng sa pula sa boboatsatsi, metsotsonyana e se kae fela o butse dikgoro e lekane go re fa o tsena mo teng ga sejanaga o fitlhele menang e tsene mo teng ga sejanaga le wena.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Mohikelo wa dinonyane, o itsegeng ka leina la avian influenza, o kgona go tsena dinonyane le ditshedi tse dingwe.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Ke dikgetse tse di kwa tlase ga di le sekete tse di setseng di tlhatlhetswe mo bathong, mme tse dingwe di ne di le masisi.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Gantsi go amega batho ba ba berekang le dikoko le dipidipidi, mme fela le balebeledi ba dinonyane le bone ga ba a sireletsega.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Selo se se tlwaelesegileng ko Norway ke dinokana tse di fa gare ga dithaba, tse di fetogang ka bonako go nna lefelo le le lekalekanang.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dithaba tse ga ntsi di bidiwa "vidde", go tewa lefelo le le bulegileng, le sena ditlhare le seageledi.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Kwa Rogaland le Agder ka ga ntsi di bidiwa "hei" mo go rayang lefelo le le se nang ditlhare le le nnang le apesitswe ke ditlhatshana.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Kgatselo e e tsamayang ga e a itshetlela, mme e elela mo thabeng. Se se kgona go dira go re marogo a kapoko a bipege a bo a sa bonale.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Mabota a magaga a metsi a a gatsetseng a kgona go phutlhama, ebile diphatlha tsa teng di kgona go tswalaga.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ko dithokong tsa kgatselo e, kgatselo tse di tona tla bo di robega, di wela fa fatshe kana di tlola kana di kgokologa go tswa mo matlhakoreng.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Paka ya bojanala kwa dithabeng, ga ntsi e tlhatloga ka selemo sa se-India.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Go tswa go le jalo, bana le bontle jo bo sa tshwaneng le go kgatlhisa ka mariga, le mafelo a dithaba a bonang sefako se se itekanetseng e bile a fana ka metshameko e tshwana le skiing le snowboarding.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ke difofane di le mmalwanyana tse di sentseng di duedisa bapagami ba ba yang diphitlhong ka tshoganyetso, ditlhwatlhwa tse di fokoditsweng go le sekae.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Ditlamo tsa difofane tse di neelanang ka se di akaretsa Air Canada, Delta Airlines, le Lufthansa mo difofaneng tse di emelelang go tsa kwa Amerika le Canada, le WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Mo maemong otlhe, o tshwanetse go tsenya kopo ka mogala ka tlhamalalo kwa difofaneng.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
